QuestInfo.name: [Home] Beach Townhouse Expansion
QuestInfo.0:
You received a new blueprint for drastically expanding the size of the Beach Townhouse! Have a discussion with Jenny construct the Cafe add-on.

#r* Note: Only one type of Home expansion quest can be active at one time.#k
QuestInfo.1: Gather the materials necessary to expand your Beach Townhouse by meeting your daily quota. You can get them by defeating enemies near your level.
QuestInfo.2: You reached today's quota for materials to expand your Beach Townhouse. There'll be more work to do tomorrow.
